item.title: Eliza Shannon on “Something’s in the Water”
item.description: In the contest-winning story “Something’s in the Water” by Eliza Shannon, Christine and two other teens are halfway across Lake Passamoonshine, trying to earn their summer camp swim badges, when things take a harrowing turn. Patrick Ryan chatted with Shannon about the inspiration behind the story, writing suspense, and her favorite horror books and movies.
